The A6 scenario arms are therefore driven by the shipped C1 kit the joint driver is derived from, with the same Officer/plane flags, on the same pinned host and SHA. One such no-op run is kept as joint-j-run3-a6flags-ignored.

One joint boot was started with C1_A6_STICKY_STOP=1. That flag changes the mock Officer handler to answer C1_A6_STICKY_STOP_PENDING and invalidates the base A6 allow scenario (J02/J03/J04/J05/J06/J11 FAILed for instrument reasons, not product reasons). It was killed, the world was removed by path, and the evidence is kept quarantined as joint-j-run1-INVALID-invocation-a6stickyflag. No verdict in this record uses it.
